title: The Upstarts
author: Brad Stone
description: The inside story of how Uber and Airbnb defied every conventional rule, disrupted entire industries, and remade the world — told by the journalist who had the closest access to both companies at their most chaotic.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A famous painter shoots her husband five times and then never speaks again. A criminal psychotherapist becomes obsessed with uncovering her motive — and the truth, when it comes, changes everything.

title: Make Your Bed
author: Admiral William H. McRaven
description: Ten lessons drawn from Navy SEAL training that argue small disciplined acts — starting with making your bed every morning — build the mental toughness to change your world and the world around you.

title: The Body Keeps the Score
author: Bessel van der Kolk
description: A landmark work on trauma — how it reshapes the brain and body, why it can't be talked away, and the range of therapies that offer genuine healing. Challenging to read, impossible to ignore.

title: $100M Offers
author: Alex Hormozi
description: A direct, no-fluff guide to crafting offers so compelling that customers feel foolish saying no — built from Hormozi's experience scaling multiple businesses past eight figures.
